name: FoundryVTT G2 HUD
description: Foundry VTT D&D 5e character sheet HUD on Even Realities G2: your character, the scene map and your actions, streamed from your own Foundry tab and driven by R1 ring gestures.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talks only to the EvenFoundryVTT relay, which forwards end-to-end encrypted messages between these glasses and the player's own Foundry tab. No Foundry login on the phone.

permissions.name: camera
permissions.desc: Scans the pairing QR shown in Foundry («Collega occhiali G2»). The photo is decoded on the phone and never uploaded.
